content_of_post_to_comment: I wonder if accepting that it’s wrong to consume problematic media (e.g visual novels with intense gore) infers that it’s also wrong to listen to problematic music (e.g mysagonystic lyrics). My thought is thus: If “it’s just fiction” is a bad argument, “it’s just music” is seemingly an equally bad argument, and all arguments against consuming problematic fiction can be placed towards problematic music
comment: The key distinction may be between content that depicts harm and content that conditions us to accept it. Medium alone may not decide the moral weight; context, intent, and effect matter.
